AppUsageMetricDto.description: Metric entry for per-application generation count.

CommitDraftRequest.description: HTTP request contract for committing an uploaded template draft.

CommitDraftResultDto.description: Result returned after committing a template draft to permanent storage.

CreateApiKeyResultDto.description: Result returned immediately after creating an API key, containing the one-time plain-text key.

CurrentUserProfileResultDto.description: Profile result returned by GET /api/v1/auth/me for current authenticated user.

DataConnectionResultDto.description: Result DTO representing a safe database connection definition (connection string omitted).

DatasetColumnSchemaDto.description: Schema metadata for a single column discovered from query execution.

DatasetResultDto.description: Result DTO representing a dataset query and cache configuration.

DocumentJobDto.description: DTO representing the state of an asynchronous document generation job.

DocumentVersionDto.description: DTO representing an immutable document version in the legal audit trail.

DownloadUrlResultDto.description: Pre-signed document download URL and validity window.

DryRunDatasetRequest.description: Request payload to test-run a SQL dataset query and discover column schemas.

DryRunDatasetResultDto.description: Result returned from dry-running a SQL dataset query, containing discovered column schema and sample rows.

FieldMappingDto.description: DTO representing an individual template placeholder-to-datasource mapping rule.

GenerateDocumentRequest.description: HTTP request contract for document generation.

GenerateDocumentResultDto.description: Result returned after document generation and MinIO persistence.

GenerationLogDto.description: DTO representing an execution log entry for document generation.

LoginResultDto.description: Result returned upon successful login authentication.

LogMetricsDto.description: Aggregated usage and performance metrics for document generations.

LogPayloadResultDto.description: Resolved payload result for an audit log entry.

instance.description: Request path that produced the problem.

errors.description: Field-level validation errors: property-to-messages map on 400, or rule-violation list on 422.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Request payload for renewing access tokens using a refresh token.

RollbackVersionResultDto.description: Result returned after rolling back a template version.

SaveFieldMappingItemDto.description: Item DTO for saving/updating field mapping configurations.

SaveHtmlRequest.description: HTTP request contract for saving updated template HTML and page layout settings.

SaveHtmlResultDto.description: Result returned after saving HTML in Monaco Studio.

SaveTemplateDatasetsRequest.description:
HTTP request contract for linking datasets to a template.
Wraps collection items in a top-level object to conform to OWASP and REST standards.

SaveTemplateMappingsRequest.description:
HTTP request contract for saving (replacing) all field mappings of a template.
Conforms to OWASP and REST standards by wrapping collection items in a top-level object.

ScanFieldsResultDto.description: Result returned after scanning placeholders from a template stream or stored template.

TemplateDatasetDto.description: DTO representing a dataset attached to a template with an alias.

TemplatePageSettings.description:
Value object defining paper geometry, orientation, margins, and header/footer definitions for templates.
Defaults to standard A4 portrait with 15mm top/bottom and 10mm left/right margins.

TemplateResultDto.description: Safe immutable Result DTO for templates, strictly isolating Domain Entities from Presentation.

TemplateSchemaDto.description: Schema contract DTO for external API consumers and form builders.

TemplateStudioDto.description: Bundle DTO loaded by the Monaco Web Studio editor.

TemplateValidationResultDto.description: Syntax validation and placeholder extraction result.

TemplateVersionDto.description: DTO representing an immutable version of a template file and its configuration snapshot.

TestDataConnectionResultDto.description: Result returned after testing connectivity to an external database.

TokenResultDto.description: Result returned upon token refresh containing a newly issued token pair.

TransferProjectOwnerRequest.description: Payload to transfer project ownership / Master Credential authority to a new user.

UpdateTemplateMetadataRequest.description: HTTP request contract for updating template metadata.

UploadFontResultDto.description: Result DTO returned after successfully uploading a font file to storage.

UserProfileDto.description: User profile data embedded in login tokens and responses.

UserResultDto.description: DTO representing user membership in a project.

ValidateStandaloneSchemaResult.description: Result DTO returned by the standalone schema validation use case.

ValidateTemplatePayloadResult.description: Result returned after pre-flight template payload schema validation.

ValidationErrorItem.description:
Domain Value Object representing a single validation error in a schema contract evaluation.
Pure C# POCO with zero framework or external library dependencies.
